## Description

Diagnoses an organization's capacity to absorb and sustain a Brown Field integration or Green Field ramp-up. Produces readiness scores, capability gap analysis, and integration/change-management cost estimates that feed the financial model and compensation-harmonization analysis. Use when: "organizational readiness", "change readiness", "change capacity", "readiness assessment", "transformation readiness".
